name: Shore path
purpose: A short, low, dark walk along the cavern's south-east wall toward the sound of surf: the warm park falls behind, a cold blue light grows at the end, and a small black torii marks where the spring meets the sea.

ceiling_profile.note: A rock overhang/cleft along the vault wall: 3 m in the middle, flaring to 4.5 m (ceiling_z -62.5) at the wave end for the torii.

portals.note: Beach top is -67.5: three 17 cm steps down just past the portal.

hero.why: A sea torii marks the threshold from the spring's last pool to the open ocean; framed in it, the moonlit sea mouth is the brightest (cold) thing in this dark passage.

water.note: Splash-pool overflow in a slot at the south wall foot, out onto the beach and down to the sea.

sightlines.see: A dark low passage whose end glows cold blue-white: the sea mouth and moon through the torii.
Looking back: the orange of the lava wall at the far end.

concept.match: The moonlit arch of 20 seen through a dark frame (torii and overhang), warm lantern pair at the sides.

lights.why: Sparse ankle light only; long dark gaps so the blue end dominates.
Warm pair at the torii posts against the cold sea light.

mood.key: cold blue at the end of a dark passage
mood.palette: dark basalt, two warm lanterns, moon-blue ahead
mood.mist: sea spray drifting in at the torii

waivers.reason: Darkness is the point here (contrast before the beach reveal).
